items.text: LiDAR acquisition, processing and QC for 12 western NC counties / Imagery acquisition, process and QC for 13 western NC counties.
Progressive delivery to the Collaboratory and NCEM of data up through May 2025.
Aircraft are mobilizing with expected acquisition for lidar to begin by weekend of 1/11-1/12, weather dependent
Acquisition for lidar running in tandem with NCEM project – teams will collect lines each day based on weather windows
Lidar acquisition could likely take 4-5 weeks depending on weather
Orthophotography data capture to begin in late January once appropriate sun angle is achieved
Lidar to be processed in blocks and delivered intermittently when data is ready
Orthophotography will be rectified against new lidar DEM data, except in Alexander that will use the existing DEM for rectification with updates only in areas of change
